nodes.label: Rising Trend Line Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: Shared visual identity across every icon: an amber/gold zig-zag uptrend line ending in a ringed node, over an olive filled area chart on a near-black (#0d1117-like) ground with a teal baseline. The rising line signals a trading/portfolio-performance product; the dark ground matches a dark-first UI so the icon does not glare in browser tabs or on dark home screens. Only two accent hues (amber, teal) so the mark stays legible when rasterized down to 32px.

nodes.label: Rounded Squircle Container Treatment
nodes.rationale: The standard icon-* and apple-touch-icon variants bake the rounded-square shape into the PNG with transparent corners, because platforms that consume the 'any' purpose (browser tabs, iOS home screen) do not clip the artwork themselves. The artwork is drawn edge-to-edge inside that shape to maximize legible mark size.
